//: Type-checks every recipe, wiring file and runner case against the
skipLibCheck is false on purpose: it is what makes an invented API a
compile error instead of a surprise at run time.
cookbook/ is not an npm workspace (scripts/manifest.mjs would take it for
an app), so the root `typecheck` script runs `tsc -p cookbook` itself.
runner/app, the verification app, has its own tsconfig (it uses
vite/client and the virtual:cyweb-app-meta module, which a recipe must
not), and the root `typecheck` script runs it too.
